steps.content: Yingying holds your hand as she glides through the air, her purple form floating like a fish paper lantern.
It seems only you and the other spirit locals can see her, while DisCity's people remain oblivious. Together, you merge into the festive crowd along the main street.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The fete's main activities only last for three days. By midnight tonight, you'll see the locals wrapping up their stalls, tidying the streets, checking their stocks, and tallying up their earnings.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: And most importantly... they'll gather all the wish slips from the wisteria branches and transcribe them onto sky lanterns.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Tomorrow, as the locals bid farewell to their guests, they will light up the lanterns, carrying the wishes to the heavens above, blessing all the visitors with good fortune for the year ahead.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: So, this is your final opportunity to make a wish to the Wisteria Fairy. Don't be shy, spill your heart's desire!
She circles around to face you, arms spread wide with a playful smile.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Since when do Eastian gods have any say in DisCity's affairs? Besides, it's all just a made-up story.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come on now. A wish is a wish, no matter where it's from. Look!
She points to the wish slips fluttering down from the wisteria branches. Among the unfamiliar Eastian characters, you easily spot the ones written in Dis language.
Unable to resist, you reach out to examine them, immediately recognizing some familiar handwriting.

steps.speaker: Dudu's Wish
steps.content: I hope business picks up next year! Less funerals and more celebrations, better earnings for the diners, and may Syndicate prosper ever more!

steps.speaker: OwO's Wish
steps.content: I wish I could go back to Goldionville next year! Oh wait, I can do that myself, let me change it. I wish I could take everyone to Goldionville for Spring Festival next year! And they can all see my lion dance!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Look how earnest and joyful your DisCity friends are.

steps.speaker: Option
options: And they are all trapped here by you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I still haven't settled the score with you about how you've trapped everyone here.
You roll your eyes at her, but can't help searching for more wish tags written in familiar script.

steps.speaker: Eugene's Wish
steps.content: I'm just hoping for more bonuses, catching a few more S-Class Sinners maybe, or at least not running out for nothing...

steps.speaker: Wynn's Wish
steps.content: Hope next year will be peaceful, with less overtime and more days off so I can grab some time to date some hot guys!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier's Wish
steps.content: Hope this crisis ends soon, along with the Tide of Ashes and those Black Rings... Above all, I wish for peace in the city, so everyone can live their lives undisturbed.

steps.speaker: Nurse's Wish
steps.content: Hope we can make another breakthrough in Mania research, so everyone can return to their normal lives.

steps.speaker: Nightingale's Wish
steps.content: May all be well.
You lower the wish tag in your hand and look around. As your wariness fades away, the true splendor of this spirit fete finally unfolds before your eyes.

As the hour of closure draws near, the street grows even more vibrant. Vendors energetically promote their goods, games and treats abound, and everyone rushes to savor these final moments. The beating of drums mingles with the crowd's chatter, while lantern light illuminates smiling faces. Under the wisteria branches, some still furiously scribble and rewrite their wishes, searching for just the right words.
You realize it's not just the bizarre appearances of the spirits here that feel strange to you—it's also how the people of DisCity wear such carefree expressions, unburdened by any shadow of worry.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Any ideas coming up? You're not planning to wish for a hundred more wishes, are you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you weren't up to no good, this could really be a wonderful place... like a perfect, heartwarming story.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's so different from the world outside... from my time.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Your time... what is it like?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those old days...
Those memories are always the first to surface. You begin slowly, narrating your experiences to her as if recounting a tale.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Where I'm from, we don't have the custom of making wishes, because there's no flower fairy to grant them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if we did have one, could the flower fairy grant my wish to end the calamities and erase Mania? I doubt it. Surely many others would have wished for the same thing, and if this wish really came true, our world wouldn't be the way it is now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's why I don't make wishes. Some wishes, once spoken out loud, only remind us of how impossible they are. Better to keep them unspoken.
For once, Yingying's usual smile fades away. She listens in silence, her eyes fixed on you until you finish speaking. A long moment passes before she finally speaks again.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...That's amazing!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Your story is just as fascinating as any tale. Won't you tell me more? I'd love to hear it.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: .........Did you even understand what I was saying?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Of course I did! That was quite the year-end review!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Over the past year—two years? Or even longer...? You've fought countless battles and overcome endless challenges to protect your city and the people you care about.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Despite all the unexpected disasters and shocking twists of fate, despite all the suffering you've endured... you've powered it through to another year. That's truly remarkable.
She starts clapping her hands, and her odd sincerity melts away the annoyance within you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Never mind. Our worlds are too far apart. It was a bit silly of me to talk about those serious matters with a "spirit" like you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Let's go.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come now, we're not so different! How about I tell you a story?
She links her arm with yours, wearing a sweet smile.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Once upon a time, there was a little girl, born beneath the wisteria vines and raised among the blooming flowers. Everyone at the Wisteria Pavilion was like a mother to her, and everyone on Bloomfete Street—they were all her fathers, uncles, aunts, brothers, and sisters.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Everyone said she was a child of the millennium-old wisteria, born to be the guardian of these streets. And when she grew up, she would become a flower fairy and grant the wishes of all who came to pray at the fete.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: And so, day after day, the little girl practiced her magic skills, and year after year, carefully noted down every wish made by every visitor. She vowed that once her powers were strong enough, she would grant them all, one by one.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Later, she found her old baby swaddling clothes. Tucked away inside were her birth record and a faded wish tag.

<i><color=#7683a2><size=27>There's a war outside. I can't keep her with me anymore, and I likely won't return.
I've left all my savings here. I'm sorry. Please take care of her.</color><i></size>

<i><color=#7683a2><size=27>This street is the best I've ever walked on, and you're the kindest people I've ever known. Please, look after her.
May the sacred wisteria watch over her. Let her grow up in a place full of hope, where she can always look forward to a brighter year.</color><i></size>
<i><color=#7683a2><size=27>Don't let her end up like me.</color><i></size>

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: In this story, there is no wish-granting flower fairy—only people powerless to change their fate.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Does a story like this feel a little closer to home?
You freeze in your tracks, words catching in your throat.
Yingying turns to look at you, offering a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Their times were just as troubled. War raged everywhere, visitors dwindled, and fetes became harder to uphold. Even the weather grew erratic—winters lost their chill, and wisteria bloomed when New Year should have brought snow.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Life was a constant struggle—exhausting and painful. Hard work went unrewarded, and misfortunes struck without warning.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: And when things got even worse, they'd somehow survive until the new year, only to find themselves unable to wish for anything—they couldn't even imagine what better days would look like anymore.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Or perhaps, as you said, they simply didn't dare to hope. Afraid to wish for the unattainable, terrified that another shattered dream would only make the fall more painful.
As she speaks softly, her hand traces the red silk ribbons hanging among the flowering vines along the eaves.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Yet even in the darkest times, the people of this street never thought of canceling the fete. Visitors still came to celebrate the New Year, waiting to see the wisteria bloom as it did every year.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Because celebrating the New Year wasn't just about welcoming another year...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: It was also to bid farewell to the past.
With one arm linked with yours, Yingying walks forward. Her free hand brushes against the dormant vines, and at her touch, they spring to life—new buds emerging and blossoming into flowers.
Her eyes remain fixed ahead, yet seem to gaze into something beyond sight.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: A new year has begun. The past is behind us, no longer holding sway. It's time to remember to release those that weigh too heavily on your heart.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Time is always fair and powerful. All those weighty burdens—regret, confusion, anger, remorse, and sorrow... you can entrust them all to time's keeping. Step forward unburdened, leaving the past year behind and embracing the new.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Your time may not be the best of times, but it's certainly not the worst. Because you're there, doing your best, and you're not alone.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since the New Year has arrived, and you have to look ahead regardless, why not find something to look forward to?
As she speaks, Yingying turns to face you, gently tightening her grip on your hand. Between your clasped hands, a wish tag has mysteriously appeared.
She gives you another smile.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Even if you can't count on things getting better, you don't have to persuade yourself they'll only get worse, right?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Besides, I think you could afford to be a little more optimistic.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: You may feel quite weary, but all your friends are looking forward to the New Year. Isn't that a reward for all your efforts this year?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I believe you can make your wishes come true, even without the flower spirit's help.
Leaving the past year behind and embracing the new...
[Vibe a bit]
Before you can speak, the crowd suddenly erupts in excitement, their hands shooting up to point at the sky.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Look, a shooting star!
A brilliant shooting star streaks past, its crimson tail stretching across half the night sky. The trail lingers, refusing to fade, rivaling even the brightest fireworks in the distance.

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: Make a wish! Make a wish!! It's now or never! Quick!

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: Hold on, isn't this the Wisteria Fairy's territory? Talk about being unfaithful, haha!

steps.speaker: Visitor
steps.content: Hey, this shooting star must be the Wisteria Fairy showing her divine powers! This year's wishes are bound to come true! Let me go first—I wish to win back all the money I've lost!
A swift kick sends him flying out.

steps.speaker: Gold Toad
steps.content: Gamblers losers. No matter how many times I tell them, they never listen. If only fewer fools would keep throwing their money at me... maybe then I could finally retire.

steps.speaker: Pixiu Dragon
steps.content: Since you've got cash to spare, boss, how about lending some to yours truly? It's been ages since I last visited the Dragon Palace, and I do miss it.

steps.speaker: Lady Rakshasa
steps.content: Then I wish for an easier year, with less drama and fewer troublemakers messing around. I don't really want to play the tough girl all the time—
The little wisp spins around excitedly, sending sparks flying everywhere. It urges Wuhuanzi to look up at the sky.

steps.speaker: Wuhuanzi
steps.content: Make a wish...?

The ghostly street, once veiled in Yugu's "refinements," finally shows its true essence as all traces of the sinister and mysterious fade away. Humans and spirits alike flood the streets, marveling at the auspicious shooting star overhead. Some rack their brains for wishes yet unmade, while others, having already decided, eagerly scramble to make even more.

steps.speaker: Vigorous Flower Spirit
steps.content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find herself a handsome one. Let them visit us during festivals so we can feast our eyes upon such a lovely sight!
steps.female_content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find herself a pretty one. Let them visit us during festivals so we can feast our eyes upon such a lovely sight!

steps.speaker: You've succeeded; no one will take your place, nor will anyone seek to destroy you. From now on...
steps.content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find herself a wealthy one. Let her be well-fed and healthy, never again having to worry about her life!

steps.speaker: Alluring Flower Spirit
steps.content: Wisteria Fairy, hear my prayer! May Yingying live a blessed life and find her true love. Wherever they may go, let them be blessed with happiness for all their days!

Wishes pour forth in both Eastian and Disian—refined and vulgar, aristocratic and plebeian, proper and indecorous—all interweaving until distinct voices meld into a singular chorus. What lingers is nothing but the sincerest wishes of many souls.

The past seems to fade in importance as the new year takes physical form, materializing as dancing dragons and lions. It prances over firecrackers and rides waves of cheers, its radiant joy flowing from the main streets down to the smallest alleyways.
Just as it reaches the very end of your sight, a bright clash of gongs and drums rings out—

steps.speaker: Mad Gourd
steps.content: A bright future awaits! A bright future awaits!
Before you realize it, you find yourself looking up—at the sky, at the horizon ahead, at the crowds welcoming the New Year.

Perhaps it's the infectious mood of celebration, or maybe it's the realization that not every wish must carry the weight of the world. Now, the notion of having something to look forward to doesn't seem so bad after all.
With that, you glance at the blank wish tag in your hand, then at the flower fairy beside you who has been eagerly encouraging you to make a wish.
—Only then do you notice that she has fallen into an unusual silence, a departure from her usual vibrant self.

She offers no jests or words of encouragement—she doesn't even look your way. Instead, she remains motionless with a profound gaze upon the sky, standing out amidst the jubilant uproar. It's as if all the lights and merriment flow through her toward the future, while she alone remains rooted in place.
Only the dazzling shooting star falls into her eyes, eternally glistening.
Sensing your gaze, she finally stirs from her trance and turns to you, the starlight in her eyes fading away.
Her familiar smile returns to her face, but for the first time, you sense an inexplicable distance between you.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: See? I didn't lie about the best part of the fete. Isn't it wonderful?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: A fete should be vibrant and full of life. Even if just for a moment, as long as it helps people forget their worries and find joy, it's accomplished its purpose.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Me? I'm having a great time, just a little tired, that's all.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I've had so much fun that I'm completely worn out. Time for me to get some sleep. You go on and enjoy yourself.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Look, the little lion dancer is looking for you, and your friends from DisCity too. There's still a couple of hours before the end—make the most of it with them.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: And, do remember all the happiness you witness, and all the lovely locals you meet here. It will make the perfect ending for this Fete. I'd really appreciate it. Now, off you go.

Have you had a good time? You want to tell her your answer, but your friends have already arrived. They pull you along in their laughing, bustling crowd, leaving you only a fleeting moment to glance back.
You catch a glimpse of Yingying standing among the fading lanterns, their dim light revealing a fragility you hadn't noticed before.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Goodbye.
A rain of flower petals falls, and she vanishes without a trace.
